appLocale.description: TECHNICAL, DO NOT TRANSLATE AS A WORD. Replace 'en' with the Chrome locale code of your translation, e.g. zh_TW, zh_CN, ja, ko, fr, es. It controls date, time and number formatting.

extName.description: Name of the extension (a product name), shown in the Chrome Web Store and on the Extensions page. 'Pixel' refers to pixel-art graphics; 'Pals' = friends. You may keep it in English or create a catchy local name. Max 45 chars.

extDescription.message: Adopt a pixel-art pet that lives in your browser, keeps you company while you study, and helps you plan your week.
extDescription.description: Short description of the extension, shown on the Extensions page and in the Chrome Web Store. Max 132 chars (Chrome limit).

actionTitle.description: Tooltip shown when the mouse hovers over the extension icon in the toolbar. Max 30 chars.

speciesCat.description: Name of an animal the user can choose as a pet (noun, singular). Shown under its picture. Max 10 chars.

speciesDog.description: Name of an animal the user can choose as a pet (noun, singular). Shown under its picture. Max 10 chars.

speciesRabbit.description: Name of an animal the user can choose as a pet (noun, singular). Shown under its picture. Max 10 chars.

speciesHamster.description: Name of an animal the user can choose as a pet (noun, singular). Shown under its picture. Max 10 chars.

defaultNameCat.description: Suggested name for a pet cat, used if the user does not type their own name. Adapt it to a short, cute pet name that sounds natural in your language. Max 12 chars.

defaultNameDog.description: Suggested name for a pet dog, used if the user does not type their own name. Adapt it to a short, cute pet name that sounds natural in your language. Max 12 chars.

defaultNameRabbit.description: Suggested name for a pet rabbit, used if the user does not type their own name. Adapt it to a short, cute pet name that sounds natural in your language. Max 12 chars.

defaultNameHamster.description: Suggested name for a pet hamster, used if the user does not type their own name. Adapt it to a short, cute pet name that sounds natural in your language. Max 12 chars.

adoptTitle.description: Heading of the first screen, where the user picks an animal (cat, dog, rabbit or hamster). Max 30 chars.

adoptNameLabel.description: Label of the text field where the user types a name for their new pet. Max 30 chars.

btnAdopt.description: Button (VERB): confirm the chosen animal and name and start looking after the pet. Max 10 chars.

settingsPetTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section where the user can rename the pet or change the animal. Max 24 chars.

fieldPetName.description: Form field label: the pet's name. Max 12 chars.

fieldSpecies.description: Form field label: which animal the pet is (cat, dog, rabbit, hamster). Max 12 chars.

btnSavePet.description: Button (VERB): save the new pet name/animal. Max 10 chars.

petSaved.description: Short confirmation shown next to the Save button after saving. Max 16 chars.

tabPet.description: Navigation tab label (noun). Opens the page where you look after your pet. Max 10 chars.

tabFocus.description: Navigation tab label (noun). Opens the study timer (Pomodoro timer). Max 10 chars.

tabTimetable.description: Navigation tab label (noun). Opens the student's weekly class timetable. Max 10 chars.

tabSettings.description: Navigation tab label (noun). Opens the settings page. Max 10 chars.

petGreeting.description: Greeting at the top of the Pet page, said by the pet itself. PETNAME is the name the user gave the pet. Informal, friendly tone. Max 30 chars.

statHappiness.description: Label above a progress bar showing how happy the pet is (0-100). Max 14 chars.

statEnergy.description: Label above a progress bar showing how much energy the pet has (0-100). Max 14 chars.

statLevel.description: Badge showing the pet's level, like in a game. Max 12 chars.

statXp.description: Progress text under the level badge. XP = experience points (game term). Max 40 chars.

titleNewcomer.description: Pet title (rank) from level 1, shown under the pet's name. Must suit any animal and any pet name. Max 20 chars.

titleStudyBuddy.description: Pet title (rank) from level 3: a friend you study with. Must suit any animal. Max 20 chars.

titleBookworm.description: Pet title (rank) from level 5: someone who loves reading. NOT an insect. Must suit any animal. Max 20 chars.

titleScholar.description: Pet title (rank) from level 8: a learned, studious person. Must suit any animal. Max 20 chars.

titleProfessor.description: Pet title (rank) from level 12, the highest. University teacher, used playfully. Must suit any animal. Max 20 chars.

wardrobeTitle.description: Heading above the accessories the pet can wear. Max 20 chars.

accNone.description: Wardrobe option: the pet wears no accessory. Max 10 chars.

accBow.description: Accessory: a ribbon bow worn on the head. NOT a bow and arrow, NOT bowing. Max 10 chars.

accGlasses.description: Accessory: a pair of reading glasses (spectacles). NOT drinking glasses. Max 10 chars.

accCap.description: Accessory: a graduation cap (square academic hat, mortarboard). Max 10 chars.

accCrown.description: Accessory: a gold crown, like a king or queen wears. Max 10 chars.

accSecret.description: Label under a locked wardrobe item, so its name stays a surprise until it is unlocked. Usually kept as '???'. Max 10 chars.

accSecretItem.description: Read by screen readers for a locked wardrobe item whose name is still hidden. Max 20 chars.

accLocked.description: Tooltip on a wardrobe item the pet cannot wear yet. Max 40 chars.

btnFeed.description: Button (VERB, imperative): give food to the pet. NOT a news feed. Max 8 chars.

btnPlay.description: Button (VERB, imperative): play with the pet. NOT 'play' a video or music. Max 8 chars.

btnNap.description: Button (VERB, imperative): let the pet take a short sleep. Max 8 chars.

moodHappy.description: Status line on the Pet page when the pet is very happy. Max 40 chars.

moodOkay.description: Status line on the Pet page when the pet's happiness is medium. Max 40 chars.

moodSad.description: Status line on the Pet page when the pet is unhappy. Max 40 chars.

moodTired.message: $PETNAME$ is sleepy. Maybe take a nap?
moodTired.description: Status line on the Pet page when the pet has low energy. Suggests pressing the Nap button. Max 40 chars.

reactFeed.description: Speech bubble said by the pet after being fed. Cute, informal. Max 24 chars.

reactFull.description: Speech bubble said by the pet when it has been fed too many times recently. Max 24 chars.

reactPlay.description: Speech bubble said by the pet after playing. Cute, excited. Max 24 chars.

reactTooTired.description: Speech bubble said by the pet when it has no energy to play. Max 24 chars.

reactLevelUp.description: Speech bubble said by the pet when it reaches a new level (game term). Excited. Max 32 chars.

reactNewItem.description: Speech bubble when a level-up unlocks an accessory, which the pet puts on. ITEM is an accessory name such as 'Glasses'. Max 40 chars.

reactNewTitle.description: Speech bubble when a level-up gives the pet a new title (rank). TITLE is a title such as 'Bookworm'. Max 40 chars.

reactNap.description: Speech bubble while the pet is sleeping (sound of snoring). Use your language's sleeping sound. Max 24 chars.

focusTitle.description: Heading of the Focus page. A timer that alternates study time and short breaks (Pomodoro technique). Max 24 chars.

phaseFocus.description: Label under the big countdown clock while the student is studying. Max 16 chars.

phaseBreak.description: Label under the big countdown clock during the rest period between study sessions. Max 16 chars.

btnStart.description: Button (VERB): start the timer. Max 10 chars.

btnPause.description: Button (VERB): pause the running timer. Max 10 chars.

btnResume.description: Button (VERB): continue a paused timer. Max 10 chars.

btnReset.description: Button (VERB): stop the timer and set it back to the beginning. Max 10 chars.

focusLengthLabel.description: Label of a number field: how many minutes one study session lasts. 'min' = minutes. Max 16 chars.

breakLengthLabel.description: Label of a number field: how many minutes one break lasts. 'min' = minutes. Max 16 chars.

sessionsTodayNone.message: No focus sessions yet today. Let's start one!
sessionsTodayNone.description: Shown on the Focus page when the student has not completed any study session today. Max 60 chars.

sessionsToday_one.description: PLURAL FORM 'one'. Shown when exactly 1 session was completed today. If your language has no plural forms, translate this and 'sessionsToday_other' the same way. Max 60 chars.

sessionsToday_other.description: PLURAL FORM 'other'. Shown when 2 or more sessions were completed today. Max 60 chars.

focusTip.message: Every finished focus session gives $PETNAME$ $XP$ XP.
focusTip.description: Small hint text at the bottom of the Focus page. XP = experience points. Max 60 chars.

notifFocusDoneTitle.description: Title of a desktop notification when a study session ends. Max 40 chars.

notifFocusDoneBody.message: Great work! $PETNAME$ earned $XP$ XP. Time for a $MINUTES$-minute break.
notifFocusDoneBody.description: Body of a desktop notification when a study session ends. Note the word order may need to change in your language. Max 100 chars.

notifBreakDoneTitle.description: Title of a desktop notification when the break ends. Max 40 chars.

notifBreakDoneBody.message: Ready for another round? $PETNAME$ believes in you!
notifBreakDoneBody.description: Body of a desktop notification when the break ends, encouraging the student to study again. Max 100 chars.

ttTitle.description: Heading of the Timetable page. Max 24 chars.

ttNext.description: Highlight box showing the next class today. CLASS is a course name typed by the user, TIME is a formatted time like '2:30 PM' or '14:30'. Max 50 chars.

ttNothingLeftToday.message: No more classes today. Enjoy your free time!
ttNothingLeftToday.description: Highlight box when there are no more classes for the rest of today. Max 50 chars.

ttEmpty.message: Your timetable is empty. Add your first class below.
ttEmpty.description: Shown when the user has not added any classes yet. Max 60 chars.

ttToday.description: Small tag next to the name of the current day of the week in the timetable. Max 10 chars.

ttTimeRange.description: Time range of a class, e.g. '9:00–10:30'. Adapt the dash or add words (e.g. 'from … to …') if your language needs it. Max 20 chars.

ttAddHeading.description: Heading of the form used to add a new class to the timetable. Max 24 chars.

fieldClassName.description: Form field label: the name of a course/lesson (e.g. 'Translation Technology'). Max 16 chars.

fieldDay.description: Form field label: day of the week. Max 10 chars.

fieldStart.description: Form field label (NOUN): the time the class starts. Different from the 'Start' button on the Focus page. Max 10 chars.

fieldEnd.description: Form field label (NOUN): the time the class ends. Max 10 chars.

fieldRoom.description: Form field label: classroom or location of the class. Max 10 chars.

placeholderClassName.description: Grey example text inside the empty 'Class name' field. 'e.g.' = for example. Max 30 chars.

placeholderRoom.description: Grey example text inside the empty 'Room' field. Max 20 chars.

btnAddClass.description: Button (VERB): add the class to the timetable. Max 10 chars.

btnDeleteClass.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the small × button that removes a class. Max 40 chars.

errorClassNameRequired.description: Error message when the user tries to add a class without a name. Max 50 chars.

errorTimeOrder.message: The end time must be later than the start time.
errorTimeOrder.description: Error message when the class end time is before its start time. Max 60 chars.

settingsLanguage.description: Label of a dropdown menu that chooses the language of this extension. Max 24 chars.

langBrowserDefault.description: Dropdown option: use the same language as the Chrome browser (the default). Max 24 chars.

langPseudo.description: Dropdown option for testers: shows fake accented, longer text to test the layout. Technical term. Max 30 chars.

langKeys.description: Dropdown option for testers: shows the technical key of every string instead of the text. Max 30 chars.

settingsLanguageHint.message: Chrome normally uses its own language setting. Use this menu to test a translation without changing Chrome.
settingsLanguageHint.description: Help text under the language dropdown. Max 120 chars.

settingsShowPet.description: Checkbox label: when on, the pet walks along the bottom of the web pages you visit. Max 36 chars.

settingsQaTitle.description: Heading of a tool that checks the selected translation file for common errors (QA = quality assurance). Max 30 chars.

btnRunQa.description: Button (VERB): run the translation check on the language selected in the dropdown. Max 12 chars.

qaChooseLanguage.message: Choose a translated language in the menu above first.
qaChooseLanguage.description: Message when the translation check is run but no translated language is selected. Max 70 chars.

qaAllGood.description: Result of the translation check when there are no errors. Max 50 chars.

qaSummary_one.description: PLURAL FORM 'one'. Heading of the translation check results when there is exactly 1 problem. Max 40 chars.

qaSummary_other.description: PLURAL FORM 'other'. Heading of the translation check results when there are 2 or more problems. Max 40 chars.

qaMissing.description: Translation check result type: the key exists in English but not in the translated file. Max 30 chars.

qaEmpty.description: Translation check result type: the translation is an empty text. Max 30 chars.

qaPlaceholder.description: Translation check result type: the $NAME$ placeholders in the translation differ from the English source. EXPECTED is a list like '$PETNAME$, $XP$'. Max 60 chars.

qaTooLong.description: Translation check result type: the translation is longer than the limit in the description. Max 50 chars.

qaSameAsSource.message: Same as English – is this intended?
qaSameAsSource.description: Translation check warning: the translation is identical to the English source text. Max 50 chars.

qaExtraKey.message: Key not found in the English file
qaExtraKey.description: Translation check result type: the translated file has a key that the English file does not have (maybe a typo in the key). Max 50 chars.

qaLocaleCode.message: appLocale should be your locale code (e.g. $CODE$)
qaLocaleCode.description: Translation check result: the technical string 'appLocale' was not changed to the language code. Max 60 chars.

qaLoadError.message: The file could not be read: $ERROR$
qaLoadError.description: Translation check result when the translated messages.json is broken (e.g. invalid JSON). ERROR is a technical message in English. Max 60 chars.

error.example: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 120

btnResetData.description: Button: delete the timetable and reset the pet and timer. Max 24 chars.

confirmResetData.message: This will delete your timetable and reset $PETNAME$. Continue?
confirmResetData.description: Confirmation dialog shown before resetting all data. Max 80 chars.

aboutVersion.description: Small text at the bottom of the Settings page showing the extension version number. Max 20 chars.

pagePetTip1.description: Speech bubble said by the pet on web pages when you click it. Friendly tip. Max 40 chars.

pagePetTip2.description: Speech bubble said by the pet on web pages when you click it. Friendly tip. Max 40 chars.

pagePetTip3.description: Speech bubble said by the pet on web pages when you click it. Max 40 chars.

pagePetTip4.description: Speech bubble said by the pet on web pages when you click it. Encouraging. Max 40 chars.

pagePetTip5.message: Psst… click my icon to start a timer.
pagePetTip5.description: Speech bubble on web pages. 'my icon' = the extension icon in the Chrome toolbar. Max 40 chars.

pagePetTip6.description: Speech bubble said by the pet on web pages (reminder to rest your eyes). Max 40 chars.

pagePetMinutesLeft_one.description: PLURAL FORM 'one'. Speech bubble on web pages while a focus session is running and 1 minute is left. Max 40 chars.

pagePetMinutesLeft_other.description: PLURAL FORM 'other'. Speech bubble on web pages while a focus session is running and 2 or more minutes are left. Max 40 chars.

pagePetFocusDone.description: Speech bubble on web pages when a focus session has just finished. Max 40 chars.

pagePetHide.description: Tooltip for the small × button next to the pet on web pages. Max 24 chars.
